package.description: Local Windows workflow companion for SOLIDWORKS.

en-US.description: Local Windows workflow companion for SOLIDWORKS.
en-US.longDescription:
Open-source SOLIDWORKS workflow helper with local document tools, automation,
thumbnails, and manufacturing utilities. Requires SOLIDWORKS for CAD features.
The installer and macros are unsigned. Review the release notes before installing.
en-US.name: Excelsis Helper
